help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ra: Hold a rail and right-click the top of a supporting block. Neighbours determine straight, curved and ascending shapes. Rails cannot be stacked on rails.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.se: Sneak (default Shift) and right-click a placed switch, station or depot to open settings, then Save. Left/straight/right always use the switch red triangle as the fixed reference.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ge: With an empty hand, right-click the generator and insert redstone dust or redstone blocks. Wire it to the connected railway. Power is required for normal train generation and dispatch.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.de: Right-click a depot with an empty hand for vehicle storage; adjacent chests also supply vehicles. Sneak-right-click for formation, route and automatic interval settings. The automatic limit only affects automatic trains; at zero Reset Automatic Trains recalls this depot's automatic trains. Saving attempts to dispatch one automatic train. Reset Automatic Trains recalls the old automatic trains on the line after a successful departure.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ma: Choose Station or Free mode before manual generation; neither is preselected. New manual trains remain parked. Right-click a locomotive or passenger car to board; W drives, S brakes, Sneak dismounts. Station mode stops at every station: release and press W to leave. Free mode requires manual braking. Manual trains ignore the automatic quota, including zero.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.lo: Sneak-right-click the locomotive for class and unloading destination. First manual forward movement sets its front; the first attached carriage can reset it from its position. The front follows the rail through curves. Use the connector to couple vehicles.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ca: Right-click a cargo car for its inventory; sneak-right-click for unloading settings. Only eligible stations with adjacent containers appear and changes refresh the list. Empty means no destination. Unloading requires space in the station container.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.st: Place the station directly below its stopping rail. An adjacent chest enables cargo unloading. Sneak-right-click to name it and set dwell times; choose its stopping rail in route settings and save.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.li: Hold the route setter and right-click for route management. Create/select a route, add devices in travel order, select each switch occurrence's exit and station stopping rails, then save and validate. Switch choices use the fixed red triangle.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.co: Hold the connector. Left-click one vehicle, then another to couple them. They need continuous rails and must be within 16 blocks. A formation permits one locomotive; automatic and manual trains cannot be mixed.

Left-click the selected vehicle again to cancel. Left-click two adjacent members of the same formation to uncouple between them. With the connector, sneak-right-click a vehicle for formation management. Collisions never couple vehicles.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ra: With the access setter, left-click the first corner, aim to preview, then left-click the second corner to save immediately. Right-click the list to toggle visibility, choose 16 colours, change the second corner or delete. The first corner stays fixed. Frames appear only while holding the tool; hiding does not disable access rules or place solid blocks.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.ti: Tickets have no survival recipe. Buy them at the terminal in Survival/Adventure; Creative also offers them in the item tab. Switching to a held ticket briefly shows its remaining uses above the hotbar; spending and top-ups refresh it.
help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.pa: Place and right-click the terminal, then buy uses: 1 emerald adds 10, capped at 30000. Top-ups use the main-hand ticket, then the offhand ticket, then the first ticket in inventory slot order. A new ticket is issued only if you have none. If the inventory is full when issuing a new ticket, no emerald is taken.

Walking in requires a valid ticket with uses, but entry is not charged. Q5 train passengers may enter without inspection. Exit is unrestricted: one use is charged if available, otherwise nothing. A single exit is not charged repeatedly. Real walls still block movement.

help.fabric_train_simulator.operation.fr: Place beneath a signal rail. Right-click to open the yard and use the railway configurator to add it to a line. Adjacent chests and hoppers facing the yard supply its storage. Retrieve goods from the yard or load them when the locomotive stops above it.
